usageNote: 口语短语！想用自己举例说明时就说这个，超自然，比'for instance'接地气多了！

examples.en: Take me for example, I study English every morning before work.
examples.zh: 就拿我来说，我每天上班前都会学英语。

examples.en: Many people struggle with public speaking. Take me for example, I used to shake every time I spoke.
examples.zh: 很多人都怕公开演讲，就拿我来说，我以前每次讲话都发抖。
